topics.name: Two-dimensional magnetism
topics.include: Magnetic order, excitations or control in two-dimensional or layered van der Waals materials as a primary research concern.
topics.exclude: Exclude general two-dimensional electronics without magnetism and incidental background mentions.

topics.name: Nonequilibrium quantum dynamics
topics.include: Nonequilibrium evolution, quenches, thermalization or periodic driving in quantum many-body systems as a primary concern.
topics.exclude: Exclude classical dynamics and equilibrium phase diagrams without a dynamics question.

topics.name: Perovskite photovoltaic stability
topics.include: Stability, ageing, degradation mechanisms or lifetime improvements in perovskite photovoltaics.
topics.exclude: Exclude LEDs, detectors and efficiency improvements without stability data or analysis.

topics.name: Solid-state battery interfaces
topics.include: Electrode interfaces, interfacial reactions and transport in all-solid-state batteries or solid-electrolyte systems as a primary concern.
topics.exclude: Exclude general liquid-battery SEI studies without a solid-electrolyte or solid-state-battery connection.

topics.name: Machine learning in catalysis
topics.include: Machine learning for catalyst design, reaction or adsorption prediction, catalytic simulation or experiment selection, with a contribution to catalysis.
topics.exclude: Exclude general molecular-property or materials learning without a catalytic object and incidental AI mentions.

topics.name: Gravitational-wave data analysis
topics.include: Signal detection, inference, parameter estimation, waveform models for data analysis or noise processing.
topics.exclude: Exclude hardware-only studies and astrophysics without a waveform or signal-inference connection.

topics.name: Protein structure prediction
topics.include: A primary contribution to three-dimensional protein or complex structure prediction, prediction evaluation or structural inference.
topics.exclude: Exclude downstream use of predicted structures without a contribution to the prediction problem.

topics.name: Ocean carbon cycling
topics.include: Marine carbon storage, exchange, transport, biogeochemistry or links to climate as a primary research concern.
topics.exclude: Exclude terrestrial-only carbon studies and incidental mentions of ocean uptake.

note: Effective publication scope; original configuration and amendments are retained separately.
